name: limousine
summary: Limousine service: trip bookings, locations, customers
description: Run a limousine / chauffeur service: a customer + pickup and dropoff locations + a date-time make a trip booking with a fare, moving through a queue → confirmed → active → completed flow. A bookings-focused dashboard surfaces today's and tomorrow's trips, the queue, completed trips, unpaid bookings and revenue. Quotations, invoices, receipts and expenses build on this.
author: OpenERP
